Beginning of Wave 8 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Normal Boss''', formerly called '''Boss1''', is a big and slow [[Enemies|enemy]], being slightly slower than the [[Slow]] with its modern variant, and having significantly more health than it. It is considered the first boss that you encounter in the [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Challenge Trials]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] and Basic Arena [[PVP]] modes, with the first two considering it a [[Boss]] on its first spawn. The [[Grave Digger]] has a chance to spawn the '''Normal Boss''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Normal Boss''' also has a chance of being spawned by the [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]] upon their death in the [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. Additionally, [[Tombstone]]s and [[Super Mystery]]s formerly had a chance to spawn '''Normal Bosses''' upon death. The '''Normal Boss''' also appeared in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]], in [[Cyber City]] as part of the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], was part of the [[The Classic Event]] and appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Normal Boss''' is a large humanoid that has a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a green skin color as well as a brown torso, waist and legs. It wears black spiked braces with chains attached on its lower arms. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Normal Boss''' was a large faceless humanoid that had a waist in its rig. It had a green skin color, as well as a brown torso, waist and legs. It wore black armbands with white spikes. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' has light green skin color, as well as a brown torso with tumors and brown legs. It also has chains wrapped around its arms. It has two scars on its face, forming a cross. It makes a groaning sound on death. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current [[Enemies Beta]] version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' is a large faceless humanoid that has a waist in its rig. It has a green skin color, as well as a brown torso, waist and legs. It wears black armbands with white spikes. |Version 4 |The fourth version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' is similar to the current version, except its skin was more reflective and vibrant, and it had a drooling zombie face with desaturated glowing yellow eyes. |Version 3 |The third version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' had a desaturated green skin color, a brown torso with tumors and darker brown legs. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' is similar to the third version, except it a more saturated skin color, and its torso was colored dark green while its legs were colored dark navy. |Version 1 |The first version of the legacy '''Normal Boss''' had a desaturated green skin color and grey diamond-plated torso and legs. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes. }} }} ==Strategy== *The '''Normal Boss''' has much higher health than the enemies that make their debut before it, so it is recommended to invest in additional defense before its debut. *Most towers can deal with the '''Normal Boss''' fairly effectively. **Almost any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Soldier]], [[Assassin]], [[Brawler]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] is recommended. **Stronger towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can fare pretty well if you are able to afford them, though they are not necessary. **Later on, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies are especially effective against '''Normal Bosses''' as they spawn in hordes. Such towers include the [[Rocketeer]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Mortar]]. *Early on during the game, slowing towers like the [[Freezer]] or [[Cryomancer]] can help slow down the '''Normal Boss'''. **As the first '''Normal Boss''' that spawns in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode is a [[Boss]] enemy, it gains multiple immunities, making it harder to slow down. In the case of the mentioned towers, they will only be able to slow it down but not freeze it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Modern)}} EasyNormalBoss.png|First version (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Legacy)}} NormalBoss0.png|Fourth version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) NormalBoss.png|Third version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) NormalBoss-0.png|Second version (15 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) NormalBoss-1.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 15 July 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} NormalBossWalk.gif|Current version, current walk animation (25 September 2024 – Present) NormalBossStunAnimation.gif|Current Version, current stun animation (25 September 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Legacy)}} LegacyNormalBossWalk.gif|Current version, current walk animation (8 May 2021 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1NormalBoss1.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2NormalBoss.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseNormalBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} NormalBossCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} AprUpdate2023.png|'''Normal Boss''' on the game thumbnail.
